changes: Fixed vehicle model selection so motorcycles, tricycles, land vehicles, bangka, and cargo boats render their own shapes; unknown IDs no longer turn into trucks. Added the missing rear axles to the 10-wheel truck.
Replaced the flat CSS vehicle markers with original Three.js 3D models for all 12 land and water vehicle types, rotating with navigation heading.
Added Capacitor lock-screen navigation bridges, Android foreground tracking notifications, and an iOS Live Activity widget; native builds and device tests are still required.
Added in-navigation vehicle selection with route recalculation, removed stale route and vehicle markers while calculating, and made arrival time and remaining duration easier to see.
Prevented successful authentication from remaining on the landing page when a post-login notification refresh throws, and exposed failed provider redirects instead of hiding their errors.
Added an animated nearby-category search pulse and perspective-styled vehicle models that follow the active navigation vehicle and heading.
Added a native OpenFreeMap 3D mode with accurately aligned route, nearby-place, and animated vehicle markers, plus direct navigation from unsaved planner routes.
Added explicit current-location anchoring for nearby searches and reduced the Noupe chat launcher's footprint.
Replaced the built-in chatbot with the optional Noupe widget, loaded only after explicit chatbot consent.
Updated the Privacy Policy and account-consent version to explain Noupe message processing.
Preserved nearby category search and AI fuel-price lookup while removing the old chat interface and Gemini chat code.
Corrected AI timeout diagnostics, allowed a longer response window, and clarified production App Check key requirements.
Added category-filtered Photon place search as a nearby-search fallback and shortened failed Overpass waits.
Improved nearby-category search availability with global Overpass mirrors, request time budgets, and successful-provider rotation.
Replaced abbreviated fuel price labels with distinct, professional fuel and energy icons.
Required current Privacy Policy/Terms confirmation before email, phone, and returning social sign-in.
Faster email, provider, and returning-account sign-in by opening the app immediately after authentication and verifying profiles in the background.
Added grouped nearby place categories for delivery hubs and route support with 1, 3, and 5 km search radii.
Added selectable GPS, pickup, drop-off, and map-center anchors with distance, estimated fuel/detour, ETA, and vehicle indications.
Added category markers and result actions to set a pickup, add a delivery stop, or add a non-cargo support stop that recalculates the plan.
Switched planner and navigation maps to the OpenFreeMap public vector tiles with OpenStreetMap attribution and an OpenStreetMap raster fallback.
Restyled the loading intro with a Regal Gold background, stronger logo contrast, and a smaller rotating wheel.
Added visible sign-in progress and red, field-level feedback for invalid email or password.
Improved Google and Facebook sign-in feedback and use redirect sign-in on iPhone and iPad.
Reduced duplicate profile reads and bounded profile verification time during sign-in.
Added a dismissible and reopenable step-by-step delivery planning guide.
Fixed page scrolling after sign-in by clearing the authentication modal state.
Improved nearby category searches by using the map center, limiting the search area and result size, and allowing more time for Overpass responses.
Added a slow pulse and luminous green color shift to both Start now buttons.
Improved green CTA contrast in both light and dark themes.
Added a soft, pulsing green edge glow to both Start now buttons, excluding Sign in.
Updated landing-page Sign in and Start now buttons to Spotify-inspired green with dark, high-contrast text.
Updated the RUTO system name to Smart Logistics/Delivery Planner Management System.
RuBot now introduces itself on greetings and identity questions, with Roo-Bot and Roo-Toh voice pronunciation.
Replaced Apple sign-in with Facebook sign-in, including consent-aware popup and redirect handling.
The sign-in panel explains that Google, Facebook, and phone sign-in require consent.
Installed app launches now restore signed-in sessions directly to the intro; browser launches require sign-in.
Expanded the landing-page and README system description and added a first-use guided tutorial.
Added a step-by-step spotlight tour of planner controls, app features, and navigation.
Reduced the spinning wheel in the branded intro.
Improved contrast of footer and consent links.
Added a keep-me-logged-in option for browser sessions and direct sign-in for returning browser accounts.
Preserved persistent sign-in for installed standalone apps, independently of the browser preference.
Improved mobile app-header controls, added a close button to notifications, and added a step-by-step delivery planning guide.
Highlighted landing-page sign-in and start buttons with high-contrast RUTO violet (#552583).
